svg.title: Thin layers with long descriptions
svg.text: Topsoil: dark brown, moist, organic silt with roots and
Light brown, dry, well-graded GRAVEL with sand,
subangular to subrounded, maximum size 50 mm
Reddish brown, stiff, moist, sandy lean clay with trace
gravel; iron oxide staining on fracture surfaces
Thin seam of white volcanic ash, <25 mm thick
Gray elastic silt, very soft, wet
OL – Organic silt or clay (low plasticity)
USCS symbol inferred from the material description
